stories.title: Hong Kong get title defense back on track with six wicket victory over Kuwait
stories.subTitle: ACC Trophy Elite 2010, Kuwait
stories.summary: A great team effort has got Hong Kong's ACC Trophy Elite title defense back on track as they rebounded from their first round loss to Nepal with a six wicket victory over hosts Kuwait.

image.caption: Hussain Butt led Hong Kong to victory over Kuwait with a fine unbeaten 82
image.longCaption: Hussain Butt led Hong Kong to victory over Kuwait with a fine unbeaten 82 during their ACC Trophy Elite 2010 encounter at Kuwait
